title: refactor(slo-toolkit): extract autodiagnostics core and integrate with incident-bot
author: Asha Patel
ci_status: pass (integration-tests rerun after flaky case fixed)
description: Motivation: multiple incident-bot features (oncall runbook linking, automated SLO diagnostics, and alert enrichment) share overlapping logic for extracting diagnostic hints from SLO and telemetry metadata. This PR extracts the autodiagnostics core into the shared slo-toolkit package and updates incident-bot to consume the new APIs. Goals: reduce duplication, centralize heuristics for SLO-to-runbook matching, enable independent testing of diagnostics logic, and make future improvements consumable by other services (e.g., ops-dashboard). Scope: - Introduces slo-toolkit/src/diagnostics/* containing the new AutodiagService, query adapters, and a small heuristic registry. - Replaces the previous incident-bot internal autodx module with calls to slo-toolkit. - Adds a feature flag and a gradual rollout plan to switch incident-bot to the shared implementation. - Adds unit and integration tests covering edge cases (missing SLO labels, empty telemetry links, rate-limited metadata queries). Rollout plan: feature-flagged on by default in a canary subset (10% of oncalls) for 48 hours; metrics (diagnostics_latency_ms, diag_match_rate) added to alert on regressions. Backwards compat: incident-bot exposes a compatibility shim during the transition; no user-facing API changes. This description contains implementation notes, test-summary, and migration guidance for operators.
commits: incident-bot: replace internal autodx with slo-toolkit APIs and add compatibility shim
tests: add unit tests for heuristics, adapters and negative cases
ci: update workflow matrix to include slo-toolkit package checks
docs: add runbook integration and migration notes
review_comments: Riley Nguyen: please add unit coverage for the case where SLO labels are present but telemetry links are empty — we saw a regression in a previous rollout.
Asha Patel (author): added tests for empty-telemetry and updated adapter to short-circuit with NOP diagnostics (see incident-bot/tests#L42-L78).
Samir Kulkarni: the prom adapter does a synchronous query per candidate runbook; consider batching to avoid thundering herd on prometheus in high-throughput incidents.
Asha Patel: refactored PrometheusAdapter to batch queries and added metrics prom_adapter_batch_size and prom_query_duration_ms; updated performance notes in docs.
Jenna Lee: please add a release note and migration steps for Dedicated customers that run private incident-bot forks.
Asha Patel: added runbook and migration guidance under docs/runbooks/autodiag_integration.md and included a compatibility shim for older private forks.
ci_checks: integration-tests: failed (transient timing issue) -> rerun -> passed
release_notes: Shared autodiagnostics: moved diagnostics heuristics into slo-toolkit and switched incident-bot to consume the shared implementation. Improves testability and reduces duplicate logic. No user-facing API changes; rollout behind feature flag. Operators: monitor diagnostics_latency_ms and diag_match_rate after rollout.
notes_for_ops: Feature flagged rollout at 10% for 48h; monitor metrics and rollback flag if diag_match_rate drops >10% or diagnostics_latency_ms P95 increases >200ms.
